title.en: CP and Tucker tensor component reconstruction

summary: Reconstruct a small explicit third-order tensor from supplied CP factors or a Tucker core and factors, linking component terms, slices and residual without implying uniqueness.
objective: Let users inspect exactly how outer-product CP components or Tucker core interactions contribute to each entry and compare reconstruction error under declared shapes.
intent_signals: Visualize CP rank-one tensor components and Tucker core reconstruction entry by entry.
example_prompts: Visualize CP rank-one tensor components and Tucker core reconstruction entry by entry.
negative_signals: Not matrix SVD drawn as another ellipsoid.
Not automatic rank discovery or uniqueness certification.
not_for: Large-scale fitting, ALS optimization or performance benchmarks.
Statistical interpretation of latent components without a domain model.

entities.name: Source tensor lattice
entities.guidance: Render a bounded I×J×K lattice (each dimension 1..12) with exact entry table and slice selector.

entities.name: Factor and core racks
entities.guidance: For CP show weighted factor columns a_r,b_r,c_r; for Tucker show core G and factor matrices A,B,C with declared shapes.

entities.name: Contribution and residual views
entities.guidance: Selecting (i,j,k) expands every scalar product term and links source, reconstruction and residual cells.

state_contract.model: Accept finite real X and either CP factors lambda,A,B,C with matching rank R or Tucker G,A,B,C with shapes G=P×Q×R, A=I×P, B=J×Q, C=K×R. CP reconstructs Xhat_ijk=sum_r lambda_r A_ir B_jr C_kr. Tucker reconstructs Xhat_ijk=sum_pqr G_pqr A_ip B_jq C_kr. Require each dimension/rank 1..12 and reject shape/nonfinite errors. Report Frobenius residual norm and relative residual only when ||X||_F>0.
state_contract.authority: Array values, indices, shape convention and summation own all glyphs. Component color/order is display and is not identity across refits unless explicitly matched.
actions: Switch CP/Tucker preset with compatible shapes.
Select component, core entry, tensor slice or output cell.
Scale or zero one supplied component and reconstruct atomically.
Toggle cumulative reconstruction and residual; reset exact arrays and ordering.

invariants: Every displayed Xhat entry equals the declared finite sum within tolerance.
Each nonzero CP component is a rank-one outer product scaled by lambda_r; a zero-weight or zero-factor component has rank zero and therefore rank at most one.
Tucker terms include core interactions; do not display the core as diagonal unless it actually is.
Permutation/rescaling of factor presentations may represent the same reconstruction, so component color is not semantic identity.
Relative residual is unavailable for zero source norm.
motion_guidance: Step through summands in a fixed declared order; cumulative motion is explanatory, not an optimization algorithm.
Reverse scrub subtracts stored terms and does not refit factors.
creative_affordances: Use stacked translucent lattice slices or small cubes; keep signs visible with orientation/pattern as well as color.
known_limits: The checks target reconstruction from supplied factors; they do not verify how factors were fitted or whether rank is minimal or unique.
Dense tensors are intentionally small; no computation was run.

claims.statement: Kolda and Bader define a three-way CP model as a sum of rank-one outer products and a Tucker model as a core tensor multiplied by factor matrices, with the stated elementwise sums; they note CP is a Tucker special case with a superdiagonal core and equal mode ranks.
claims.scope: Finite real third-order tensors and supplied factors; approximation, fitting and uniqueness are not inferred.

source_refs.locator: Sections 3, equations (3.1)-(3.3), and 4.1, equations (4.1)-(4.2), PDF pages 8-9 and 19-20

object_craft.structure: Put source, cumulative reconstruction and residual lattices on one indexed base with CP factor rods or Tucker core rack beside them.
object_craft.material: Signed entries use height/orientation plus hue; selected summands glow without hiding numeric labels.
object_craft.articulation: A component slider adds one stored summand; slice planes share the same i,j,k selection.

object_craft.structure: In Blender, author only static axes, labeled frames, selection glyphs and low-detail instrument housings at declared units; keep numeric curves, rasters, samples and component lattices out of baked mesh state.
object_craft.material: Use simple glTF-safe material slots and optional baked label atlases with explicit UVs. Export named anchors and static teaching geometry; unsupported procedural nodes, text and compositor marks require baked or runtime replacements.
object_craft.articulation: In Three.js, allocate numeric arrays from the validated input contract, generate dynamic lines/points/instances, bind selections by stable index, and rebuild all linked views atomically on parameter revision or reset.

physical_contract.scope: Finite algebraic reconstruction of a supplied real 3-way tensor; no fitting dynamics.
physical_contract.timestep: One stored summand per explanatory step.
checks: Spot-check selected entry by explicit scalar sum.
Verify Frobenius residual and zero-norm guard.
